items.headline: Ukraine faces fresh missile barrage and diplomatic pushes after Trump’s China visit
items.summary: Russia launched more than 400 drones and 110 missiles at Ukraine hours after President Trump met Vladimir Putin in Beijing, killing at least eight civilians.
